# Scheduler

> After / Every / Debounce / Throttle / Stopwatch.

- Package: `Scheduler` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Scheduler")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Scheduler")` (shared/client keys)

## `Gaxia.Scheduler`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/Scheduler.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local Scheduler = Gaxia.Scheduler
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local Scheduler = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.Scheduler)
```

### Functions

- `Scheduler.After(delaySec: number, fn: () -> ()): () -> ()`
  Run `fn` once after `delaySec`. Returns a cancel() that prevents it firing.
- `Scheduler.Every(intervalSec: number, fn: () -> ()): () -> ()`
  Run `fn` every `intervalSec` until cancelled. Returns cancel().
- `Scheduler.Debounce<A...>(fn: (A...) -> (), waitSec: number): (A...) -> ()`
  Returns a wrapper that delays `fn` until `waitSec` after its LAST invocation (trailing debounce) — e.g. save-on-stop-typing. The wrapper takes fn's arguments (typed) and calls fn with the LAST call's arguments.
- `Scheduler.Throttle<A...>(fn: (A...) -> (), intervalSec: number): (A...) -> ()`
  Returns a wrapper that calls `fn` at most once per `intervalSec` (leading throttle). The wrapper takes fn's arguments (typed); throttled calls are dropped.
- `Scheduler.Stopwatch(): Stopwatch`
  Simple elapsed-time clock.
